welcome_message:
PR Quiz - a merge gate that quizzes PR reviewers on the diff before allowing merge.
This template deploys the Databricks side: a UC schema, a quiz-generation job, and a Streamlit app.

project_name.description: Project name. Becomes the bundle name and the default app/job name prefix (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; must fit Databricks app-name rules, max 26 chars)
project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Must start with a lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, and be 2-26 characters.

workspace_host.description: Databricks workspace URL to deploy to, e.g. https://dbc-xxxxxxxx-xxxx.cloud.databricks.com
workspace_host.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be a full https:// workspace URL.

catalog.description: Unity Catalog catalog that will hold the quiz schema ('workspace' on Free Edition)
catalog.pattern_match_failure_message: Catalog names may contain only letters, digits, and underscores.

schema.description: Schema for the quiz tables (question_pool, quiz_results); created by the bundle
schema.pattern_match_failure_message: Schema names may contain only letters, digits, and underscores.

warehouse_id.description: ID of a SQL warehouse the app can use (Compute > SQL warehouses > your warehouse > ID)
warehouse_id.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be the 16-character hex warehouse ID (e.g. 0123456789abcdef), not the warehouse name.

serving_endpoint.description: Foundation-model serving endpoint used to generate quiz questions
serving_endpoint.pattern_match_failure_message: Endpoint names may contain only letters, digits, underscores, dots, and hyphens.

secret_scope.description: Secret scope holding the GitHub token used to fetch diffs and post statuses
secret_scope.pattern_match_failure_message: Secret scope names may contain only letters, digits, underscores, dots, and hyphens.

secret_key_github.description: Secret key (inside the scope above) holding the GitHub token
secret_key_github.pattern_match_failure_message: Secret key names may contain only letters, digits, underscores, dots, and hyphens.

status_context.description: Commit-status context the merge gate posts under; must match QUIZ_STATUS_CONTEXT in the caller workflows and the branch-protection required check
status_context.pattern_match_failure_message: Status context may contain only letters, digits, underscores, dots, slashes, and hyphens.

success_message:
Project '{{.project_name}}' initialized. Next steps: 1. cd {{.project_name}} 2. databricks secrets create-scope {{.secret_scope}} (if it does not exist yet) 3. databricks secrets put-secret {{.secret_scope}} {{.secret_key_github}} --string-value 4. databricks bundle deploy (creates the {{.catalog}}.{{.schema}} schema, the job, and the app) 5. python scripts/sql_exec.py --file sql/init_tables.sql --warehouse-id {{.warehouse_id}} (creates the quiz tables; add --profile

if you use CLI profiles) 6. databricks bundle run quiz_app
